name: Sandbox allows a dangerous Unix socket
description: sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets lists a container-runtime control socket (docker/containerd/podman) or an ssh-agent/gpg-agent socket. Either class of socket grants the sandboxed process host-level control or credential-forwarding access, escaping the sandbox's intended isolation. The dangerous-path/agent-pattern list here MUST stay in sync with claude.sandbox.unix-socket's notIn list in this same file.
message: With the sandbox enabled, sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets grants a socket that exposes host or agent-forwarding access (container-runtime control socket or ssh/gpg-agent)

name: Sandbox allows a Unix socket
description: sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets lists a socket path that is not a known container-runtime control socket and does not match the ssh/gpg-agent pattern. This list here MUST stay in sync with claude.sandbox.dangerous-socket's in-list in this same file so the two rules remain mutually exclusive.
message: With the sandbox enabled, sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets grants a Unix socket into the sandbox
